items.title: Micron Stock Dives As Semiconductor Sell-Off Gains Steam
items.summary: Micron Technology stock plunged on Tuesday as semiconductor stocks broadly continued to sell off. On the stock market today, Micron fell 8.9% to close at 820.53. It was among the worst performers on the Philadelphia semiconductor index, known as SOX.
